scope: Independent source review and cross-boundary regression

findings.before: A newly signed changed inventory with unchanged release/descriptor could pass old review
findings.after: Full canonical file-map SHA pinned in plan, journal and schema-2 resource receipt; rechecked under lifecycle lock

findings.before: Component ID network collided with infrastructure create/remove journal keys
findings.after: Intent keys include resource kind and name

findings.before: Foreign namespace consumers using container name or short ID were overlooked
findings.after: Bounded exact/prefix/name resolver before stop/removal; unresolved references fail closed

findings.before: Four fresh/resume regressions accepted re-signed runtime or added notice; 4 tests failed before fix
findings.after: Full file-map SHA in reviewed service plan and expected service receipts

findings.before: PLAN_STALE created service-manager/lock without state.json and fenced NativeEngine despite no manager effect
findings.after: Read-only identity/state/payload checks under common root lease before creating service lock directory; fresh and interrupted paths covered

findings.before: A reviewed native backup/uninstall needed protection if service registration appeared before execute
findings.after: Common root lifecycle lock plus valid service journal fence; real synthetic integration preserves process and data before refusal

findings.before: Mode choice depended on install support, hiding available maintenance actions
findings.after: Mode enabled when any action is supported; selected action separately gates Next; review resets on mode/action change

findings.before: Linux service test decorators read /proc at module import even on other OS
findings.after: Early module-level platform skip before project imports or /proc reads; synthetic win32 import guards and final Linux scoped suite pass

focused_scopes.scope: Service manager/contracts/native boundary/backend router after no-effect rejection fix

limits: Independent reproducer counts are not additional repository tests
No remaining blockers found in the reviewed scope is not proof of full product or platform readiness
